prompts.description: Fix intermittent meal-plan generation failure caused by max_tokens truncating the JSON response
prompts.prompt: Edit only app/api/generate-meal-plan/route.ts. Problem: the Claude response is sometimes cut off by max_tokens, producing invalid JSON ('Unterminated string in JSON at position ~12000') and a 500, especially for high-variety plans. Make these changes: (1) Raise the Anthropic call's max_tokens from 4000 to 8000. (2) If there is a Promise.race hard timeout currently set to 35s (35000ms) guarding the Claude call, raise it to 50s (50000ms) — but do NOT touch `export const maxDuration` (leave it at 60). (3) Around the JSON.parse of Claude's response, if a parse error is thrown, log the response length and the stop_reason if available, then throw a clear error message like 'Meal plan response was truncated (stop_reason: max_tokens) — increase max_tokens'. Do NOT change the prompt content, the meal rotation logic, adjustMacros, validateMealPlan, or any other file. Verify: npm run build passes; generating a meal plan with the most-variety / most-expensive setting succeeds consistently across at least 3 attempts without a 500.
